milestone: SeLinOS suspended child TCB control lease M1

contract.child: Root configures one separate inert child process but never spawns it; the child remains suspended throughout the proof.
contract.transfer: Objectd returns exactly one copy of that child TCB cap. Taskd receives it at a predeclared CSpace path, validates exact reply shape and does not invoke the cap.
contract.authority: No allocator, object creation, CSpace/VSpace construction, mapping, device, IRQ, DMA, PCI, I/O or IOSpace authority is delegated to the new services.

required_markers: SeLinOS TCB lease M1: dedicated child fixture configured and deliberately suspended.
SeLinOS taskd TCB lease M1: exact slot 1 request accepted.
SeLinOS objectd TCB lease M1: suspended child TCB cap transferred to taskd.
SeLinOS taskd TCB lease M1: suspended child TCB cap received and not exercised.
SeLinOS taskd TCB lease M1 probe: suspended child TCB transfer passed.
forbidden_markers: SeLinOS TCB lease M1 child: unexpected execution.
SeLinOS taskd TCB lease M1: malformed client request rejected.
SeLinOS taskd TCB lease M1: TCB cap reply rejected.

not_claimed: TCB allocation, TCB configuration, TCB suspend/resume, register/TLS setup, scheduling or any other TCB-cap exercise
dynamic child creation, child start, teardown, release, revocation or reuse
executable mapping, W^X, native ELF loading or dynamic linker semantics
Linux clone, fork, pthread, process exit, wait, signal or futex semantics
device, IRQ, DMA, PCI, I/O or IOSpace authority
